title: Historical Decision Materialization and SDD Assurance
purpose: Recover approved AIAS development decisions, distinguish binding rules from future programs, audit their repository evidence and materialize missing governance controls immediately.
scope: Decision registry, SDD enforcement, documentation coverage, asset state/version controls, Definition of Done, anti-bureaucracy, executive metrics and master development plan evidence.

requirements.title: Decision registry
requirements.statement: The system shall preserve every recovered binding decision with capture provenance, classification and evidence links.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: SDD assurance
requirements.statement: The system shall verify specification, architecture, ADR, implementation, tests and traceability before a capability is validated.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Documentation audit
requirements.statement: The system shall measure package, module and public-symbol documentation coverage without claiming undocumented code is complete.
requirements.rationale: Create an honest documentation baseline and backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Asset lifecycle
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce stable identifiers, semantic versions and one official lifecycle state per engineering asset.
requirements.rationale: Version knowledge as well as code.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Executable Definition of Done
requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate code, tests, integration, documentation, CLI, receipt, manifest, example, installer, release and validation evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Master evidence
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a master plan, compliance matrix, executive metrics and prioritized alignment backlog from repository evidence.
requirements.rationale: Turn recovered decisions into immediate, low-bureaucracy value.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
